harness.name: Claude API SDK — TypeScript
recommended_when: Low-level typed Claude API and managed-agent access from JS/TS

capabilities.summary: Typed JavaScript/TypeScript access to the Anthropic API.
invocation: import Anthropic from '@anthropic-ai/sdk'; const client = new Anthropic();

evidence.claim: Typed JavaScript/TypeScript access to the Anthropic API.
Invocation verified: npm install @anthropic-ai/sdk, import Anthropic from '@anthropic-ai/sdk'; const client = new Anthropic();

capabilities.summary: Streaming and typed response objects support machine-readable application logic.

evidence.claim: Streaming and typed response objects support machine-readable application logic.
Invocation verified: client.messages.create({tools: [...], tool_choice: ...}), strict: true (tool definition), client.messages.create({stream: true})

capabilities.summary: Model and API feature parameters are exposed as generated typed interfaces.

evidence.claim: Model and API feature parameters are exposed as generated typed interfaces.
Invocation verified: model: "claude-...", thinking: {type: "enabled", budget_tokens: N}, thinking: {type: "adaptive"}, output_config: {effort: "high"}
